subject: configure: error: missing required header GL/gl.h

messages.author: 9b09ea465f7f1f40
messages.subject: configure: error: missing required header GL/gl.h
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to install the RGL package in Glimmer. Everytime I get the error configure: error: missing required header GL/gl.h. When I look it up on google, it seems that there are some files missing somewhere, but I can't figure how to to fix it. Does anyone have a solution? Thanks in advance!
Cheers, Mart

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: configure: error: missing required header GL/gl.h
parts:
Hi, we've looked into setting up rgl on glimmer and spark, but haven't found a good secure way of making it work in a multi-user environment. Unfortunately, this means that apps that use rgl won't be able to run on these servers.

-Winston
